source.title: A Fast and Cost-Effective Electronic Nose Model for Methanol Detection Using Ensemble Learning
source.data_availability: not publicly available; may be made available on reasonable request

experiment.headspace_method: 100 mL alcohol mixture in chamber; passive evaporation; no pump or fan; constant windless temperature environment

reported_model_results.interpretation: The full 11-sensor array contains all eight HR069 MQ models, but the published feature-selection result concentrates discriminative information in MQ3, MQ4 and MQ137. Only MQ3 and MQ4 of those selected sensors are installed on HR069.

requirements_before_numeric_promotion: Obtain source raw 11-channel time series or equivalent tabulated class statistics
Define a source-to-HR069 transfer transform without synthesizing missing or unmeasured values
Validate MQ3/MQ4 response on the installed HR069 hardware under controlled methanol exposures
Keep mixture-ratio classification separate from gas-phase ppm calibration
Require M4 device/reference calibration before reportable occupational or safety-grade ppm
